verdict.rationale: Delegated-access rules are a fair question for a state business-filing authority, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never publishes authorization forms, delegate role definitions, or which signatures must stay personal. The only related items are a passing mention of Gateway 'Filing Administrator functions' and municipal portal administrators, which are adjacent role features rather than published third-party permission rules. The Secretary of State's own site (ohiosos.gov) and its filing portal both blocked access, so no first-party content on this topic was available.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
